summary: Full backend + frontend test pass for the new Verified Results proof gallery. 9/9 pytest cases pass (list shape, no base64 leak, image byte serving, 404 handling, PNG upload roundtrip, .txt rejection, delete, seed preservation). Landing gallery renders both seeded collages with img.naturalWidth>0, lightbox opens/closes via both close button and backdrop. Admin E2E upload → count 2→3 → hover-delete → count 3→2 all worked; success/removed toasts fired; seeded shots preserved after CRUD cycle.
critical_code_review_comments: proof.py is clean, small (67 lines), async, excludes _id, validates content-type + max size, and gates writes with require_write_key dependency — good posture.
ProofGallery.js correctly uses BACKEND+shot.url (no double /api) and hides section when shots.length===0 — sensible.
ProofManager.js delete confirmation uses window.confirm which is fine for admin-only usage; consider replacing with a shadcn AlertDialog for consistency, but not blocking.
MAX_IMAGE_BYTES=8MB is client-trusted only after read; consider streaming reject via Content-Length header for large uploads (not blocking for preview scale).
test_credentials: None required — RETOOL_API_KEY unset so write endpoints open in preview.
seed_data_creation: None — test creates & self-cleans a TEST_ tagged 73-byte PNG per run; seeded shots (Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 positions, Live session P&L receipts) verified untouched after CRUD.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Proof gallery feature is production-ready. Backend: /api/proof/list|image/{id}|upload|delete all pass under /app/backend/tests/test_proof_gallery.py. Frontend testids to reuse: proof-section, proof-shot-{id}, proof-lightbox, proof-lightbox-close, proof-manager, proof-file-input, proof-caption-input, proof-upload-btn, proof-admin-{id}, proof-delete-{id}. Delete button uses opacity-0 group-hover, so hover the parent proof-admin-{id} before clicking proof-delete-{id}. window.confirm dialog must be auto-accepted via page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()). Seeded PNGs are 1.2-1.7MB so give 30-60s timeouts on image byte GETs.
